summary: template options: attributes, backup, custom block and comment delimiters, the required dest, follow symlinks, and force (replace when content differs).
questions: How do I only deploy a template if the file doesn't exist?
How do I back up the previous file before templating?
How do I change Jinja block delimiters?
Does template follow symlinks at dest?

answer_card.title: template parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `dest` (required)
- `force` (true): replace when different; false = only if missing
- `backup` (false)
- `follow` (false)
- `block_start_string`/`block_end_string`, `comment_start_string`/`comment_end_string`
- `attributes`
